name: local-writing-assistant
description: Fully local AI writing assistant — Chrome extension + native host + Windows + Linux installer.

scripts.build:native: cd native-host && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags='-s -w' -o build/LocalWritingAssistantHost.exe ./cmd/localwritingassistanthost
scripts.build:native:linux: cd native-host && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags='-s -w' -o build/LocalWritingAssistantHost ./cmd/localwritingassistanthost
scripts.build:native:all: npm run build:native && npm run build:native:linux
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:integration && npx vitest run
